issue: Unable to migrate global configuration - user configuration file already exists.
cause: An existing user.ini made migration return false, leaving Pre31Migrated=false. Relative portable-mode paths could also select AppData settings when launched from a different working directory.
changes: Preserve and open an existing regular user.ini; mark migration complete only when it can be opened.
Keep the legacy copy path when user.ini is absent.
Initialize the Windows working directory from the executable before resolving runtime assets and portable-mode markers.
